notes.claim: To share in a ratio, find the total number of parts by adding the parts in each share.
A bar model shows sharing: divide the whole into five parts, then take two parts for one person and three for the other.
Three documented misconceptions in sharing in a ratio are regarding a ratio as a number, additive reasoning, and confusion about the whole.
Confusion about the whole was the most frequent misconception in one study of part-part-whole relationships.
